articles.title: EU leaders choose team for Ukraine peace talks after months of wavering
articles.summary: British representatives will be part of a team representing Europe in Ukraine peace talks.

articles.title: Man shot dead in Washington DC gym is named
articles.summary: A man shot dead in a Washington DC gym on Thursday has been named.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, health ministry says
articles.summary: An Israeli airstrike on a Palestinian hospital has killed at least six and wounded 28, Gaza's Health Ministry said.

articles.title: Bomb alert at Calais train station disrupts Eurostar
articles.summary: A bomb alert at a French train station disrupted journeys including international travel, with Eurostar trains among those affected.

articles.title: Fiery clashes erupt in Spain as millions join general strike
articles.summary: Unrest broke out in cities across Spain on Wednesday after millions of workers joined the country's first general strike in 14 years.
